scope: Historical nightly/non-Nix baseline only; not stable/Nix shipping qualification
features: default simd, stock counters; no native-core/accessibility
quantiles: within-process p50=median, p95/p99=nearest rank; report median/MAD of seven per-process values
phase_share: median across processes of sum(phase durations)/sum(total durations); phase p50 values do not sum to total p50
memory_scope: wait4 whole-child HWM including launch/setup, initial/final fresh reconstruction oracles and output buffers; not application-only or steady-state RSS; all measured child values share the same 20.88 MiB floor and do not discriminate scenario footprint
